# Countrivo

> Countrivo is a free geography games site with seven daily games and unlimited practice. No account is needed. New daily boards arrive at midnight Europe/Berlin time, and everyone gets the same boards that day. The same games are in the Countrivo iPhone app.

## Daily games

- [Country Draft](https://countrivo.com/games/country-draft): the daily world draft. Five rounds: choose one of three countries, pick one of its famous people and give them a cabinet job. Points appear after each appointment; the maximum is 195.
- [GeoWordle](https://countrivo.com/games/geo-wordle): a Wordle-style geography game. Find the hidden country in six guesses using distance and direction clues. Daily puzzle plus unlimited practice.
- [Pinpoint](https://countrivo.com/games/pinpoint): place five countries on a blank world map. Closer pins score more, the fifth round counts double, maximum 1,200.
- [Flag Quiz](https://countrivo.com/games/flag-quiz): a twenty-second flag sprint. Four names per flag, a wrong answer costs two seconds, score is the number of flags named.
- [Higher or Lower](https://countrivo.com/games/higher-or-lower): ten calls on one statistic a day, such as population or area. Is the next country higher or lower? The last three calls count double, maximum 13.
- [Stat Guesser](https://countrivo.com/games/stat-guesser): guess five numbers about countries on a ruler with two reference countries. The last round counts double, maximum 600.
- [Blind Pick](https://countrivo.com/games/blind-pick): eight countries arrive one at a time; place each on one of eight world rankings. The score is the gap to the best possible board, perfect is zero.

## Practice

- [Unlimited practice](https://countrivo.com/practice): fresh boards for every game, as often as you like, never on the leaderboard.
- [Speed Flags](https://countrivo.com/games/speed-flags): thirty seconds, two names per flag, a wrong answer costs three seconds. Practice only.
- [Flags of Europe](https://countrivo.com/practice/europe-flags): practise the flags of European countries.

## Guides and reference

- [Games like Worldle](https://countrivo.com/games-like-worldle): how GeoWordle and other daily geography games compare.
- [World Map Quiz](https://countrivo.com/world-map-quiz): find countries on a world map.
- [Capital Quiz](https://countrivo.com/games/capital-quiz): a quiz on world capitals.
- [Countries](https://countrivo.com/countries): a page for each of 243 countries and territories with population, area, capital and world rankings among the 195 sovereign states.
- [Country lists](https://countrivo.com/lists): countries by continent and by statistic.
- [Sources](https://countrivo.com/sources): where every statistic comes from, with source years and caveats.
- [About and teachers](https://countrivo.com/about#teachers): how the daily boards work, and using Countrivo in class with no accounts.

## App

- [Countrivo on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782594305): the iPhone app.
